title: [Task 3.7] Define frontend styling approach and add CSS toolchain support
body:
### Objective

Choose how ResearchHub UI is styled and make the Webpack, Jest, TypeScript and Prettier toolchain handle stylesheets and font/SVG assets accordingly. This work gives the frontend a predictable styling and asset contract before the design system and feature screens are built on it. The implementation must stay within the agreed ResearchHub architecture and avoid unrelated infrastructure or feature expansion.

### Technical Implementation Details

**Backlog reference:** RH-264
**Estimated size:** M
**Primary implementation paths:** `frontend/webpack.config.cjs`, `frontend/jest.config.cjs`, `frontend/src/env.d.ts`, `frontend/src/styles/`, `docs/adr/`
**Technology baseline:** Java 25 + Spring Boot 4.1.1 + Maven for the core backend; Spring-managed dependency versions should come from the Spring Boot BOM whenever possible; React + TypeScript on Node/npm with Webpack and Babel; frontend dependency versions must remain pinned by `package-lock.json`.
**Architecture constraints:** Keep the Spring backend as a modular monolith; enforce workspace authorization on the server for workspace-owned resources; keep AI/data Python concerns outside core Java domain logic; preserve provenance for source- or analysis-derived outputs where applicable.
**Implementation anchor:** Start from the paths above, keep public contracts explicit, and add/update configuration or migration files in the same change when the task introduces a runtime or schema dependency.

**UX:**
- ADR-006 resolving the "UI component library" item that `docs/context.md` section 37 intentionally leaves open; the recommended outcome is hand-built primitives on plain CSS custom properties with no component library;
- a global `frontend/src/styles/` entry imported from `frontend/src/index.tsx`;
- Webpack rules for CSS (global vs CSS Modules as decided in the ADR) and for font/SVG assets;
- a Jest `moduleNameMapper` or transform so a component that imports CSS renders in component tests;
- style-import type declarations in `frontend/src/env.d.ts`;
- ESLint and Prettier cover the new files and `npm run build` still type-checks.

**Out of scope:**
- design tokens and typography (Task 3.8);
- adopting a third-party component library unless the ADR chooses one;
- dark mode and theming.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] ADR-006 records the decision, the alternatives considered and the dependency consequences.
- [ ] A component can import a `.css` file in both a Jest component test and the production Webpack build.
- [ ] Coverage collection includes the new shared UI directories without lowering existing thresholds.
- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass and the repository builds successfully for the affected component.
- [ ] Minimum 80% test coverage for this module
